story_info.title: Toby Turtle's Flower Friend
story_info.subtitle: A kind act in Blossom Meadow
story_info.moral: Even small actions can help nature grow and stay beautiful.

main_character.name: Toby Turtle
main_character.appearance: Toby is a young sea turtle with a rounded teal-green shell patterned in soft swirls, gentle brown eyes, and smooth blue-green flippers. He has a calm, unhurried expression.

slides.title: A Morning in Blossom Meadow
slides.text: Toby Turtle loved Blossom Meadow. His teal-green shell shone in the morning sun. Many colourful flowers grew there. Red, yellow, and blue flowers smiled up at him. "Slow and steady discovers wonders!" Toby said softly. He loved to walk among them. He watched busy bees fly from flower to flower.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Toby and the setting, highlighting his love for nature.

slides.title: A Thirsty Little Flower
slides.text: As Toby walked, he saw a small purple flower. It looked a little droopy. Its petals were not bright and happy. "Oh, little flower," Toby thought. "You look thirsty." The ground around it was dry. Toby knew flowers need water to grow tall and strong.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce the challenge: a sad, thirsty flower needing help.

slides.title: Toby's Clever Idea
slides.text: Toby looked around with his gentle brown eyes. He saw a big, broad leaf on the ground. "I can use this!" he thought. He carefully picked up the leaf. He would carry water in it. The stream was not too far away. He knew he had to be very careful.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Toby's thoughtfulness and problem-solving, finding a simple tool.

slides.title: Bringing Water Gently
slides.text: Toby slowly carried the leaf full of water. His flippers moved steadily. He walked back to the little purple flower. "Here you go, friend," he said. He tilted the leaf gently. The cool water touched the dry soil around the flower. It drank the water slowly.
slides.speaker_notes: Describe Toby's action of carefully watering the flower, reinforcing his patient nature.

slides.title: A Happy Bloom
slides.text: Soon, the little flower began to perk up! Its purple petals lifted. It looked bright and happy again. Toby smiled. He felt warm inside. Taking care of nature made Blossom Meadow beautiful for everyone. He knew his small help made a big difference.
slides.speaker_notes: Conclude with the happy outcome and Toby's positive emotional reflection on helping nature.
